name: Abyssal Archetypes
source:
Welcome to the Golden Theater! 

I’m your host, Lord Hastur the Unspeakable, and I’m pleased to announce my latest venture, Abyssal Archetypes! 

This interactive visual novel aims to impart the glorious knowledge of the King in Yellow in a much more modern, digestible package: an all-new story with the same terrifying themes you’ve come to know and expect from my playwriting.

Enter the Abyss: a dimension powered by raw creativity, and search for your lost memories! 

Meet the many eldritch gods and some of their adorable familiars! And drive yourself insane with forbidden knowledge over, and over, and over again…

[From [url=https://leviathanmedia.itch.io/abyssal-archetypes]itch.io[/url]]
